findings.label: Bug 1 — Interval cleanup
findings.detail: useEffect returns clearInterval(interval); interval is also cleared inside setCountdown when c<=1. Confirmed.

findings.label: Bug 2 — Over-fetching
findings.detail: Vehicles and services fetched once on mount via useEffect([], []); useFocusEffect narrowed to bookings and badge only. Pull-to-refresh re-fetches all three. Confirmed.

findings.label: Bug 3 — ICU-free day name
findings.detail: toLocaleDateString removed. DAY_NAMES array present; getISTDayName uses Date.UTC(y, m-1, d, 6, 30) + IST_OFFSET_MS and reads getUTCDay(). Confirmed.

findings.label: Bug 4 — confirmed→rescheduled transition
findings.detail: ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS.confirmed includes 'rescheduled'. Reverse transition rescheduled→confirmed also present. Confirmed.

findings.label: Bug 5 — Webhook 200 when unconfigured
findings.detail: handleWebhook returns res.status(200).json({ received: true }) immediately when webhookSecret is falsy. Confirmed.

findings.label: Bug 6 — COD notification guard
findings.detail: recordCODCollection loads booking via Booking.findByIdAndUpdate and guards notifyPaymentConfirmed with if(booking). Confirmed.

findings.label: Unpopulated bookingId on no-booking early return
findings.detail: When payment.bookingId is falsy the early-return path populates and returns the payment; the populated bookingId value is null. Clients reading payment.bookingId.bookingReference without a null-check will crash. Low severity — only fires for orphaned payment records.

findings.label: Analytics — getAdminReports fields
findings.detail: monthlyRevenue, bookingsByVehicleType, bookingsByService, todayAppointments all present in response. Verified against smoke-test output in phase6-server-verification.md. Confirmed.

findings.label: Reports screen — new chart sections
findings.detail: Monthly Revenue, Vehicle Type, Top Services sections appended after existing sections. Stat cards and status chart structurally unchanged. Confirmed.

findings.label: Seed endpoint guard
findings.detail: Route registered inside if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') block evaluated at module load time. Uses exported seedServicesData function. Protected by protect + requireAdmin. Confirmed.

findings.label: colors.js — black and white defined
findings.detail: white: '#FFFFFF' and black: '#000000' present in colors object. Confirmed.

findings.label: No regressions
findings.detail: Existing routes, controllers, and screen sections are structurally unchanged. New code is strictly additive except for targeted bug-fix lines. Confirmed.

findings.label: Verification results
findings.detail: All node --check passes, server boots on port 5000, seed scripts idempotent, API smoke tests pass including /api/admin/reports with monthlyRevenue array, Expo export exits 0 with 1167 modules. One aggregation typo fixed during verification. Confirmed.
